notes.title: controller sensitivity, invert camera y-axis
notes.content:
added two new toggles to the settings menu:
- use controller (switches between controller and mouse camera control)
- invert y-axis

notes.title: Stat Tracking Update
notes.content:
Your best solo time and number of solo completions in both Standard and Hard Mode are now recorded and visible from the main menu!

This update also fixes nametags in multiplayer (I accidentally broke those with the dark mode update, woops!)
